title: Verify LR-FHSS receive feasibility
description: Identify an actual LR-FHSS receiving hardware/demodulator/software path for future LICHEN2, with bounded memory/CPU/bandwidth measurements. Distinguish SX1262/LR1110 TX capability and ordinary narrow-BW LoRa RX/TX from LR-FHSS GMSK; a generic SX1302/SX1303 label does not establish LR-FHSS reception. Review documented existing implementations before proposing new silicon/SDR work. Treat500/250Hz channel counts and50-100 simultaneous links as speculative, not measured capacity. No hardware purchases, upstream posts or licensing decisions without explicit authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Primary references identify exact supported waveform and receiver version; independent known/captured packet evidence or an explicit unverified/no-go result; tuning span, simultaneous passbands, demodulator count and TX constraints recorded separately. No implementation or certification claim from a product name alone.
